segments.environment: PHYSICAL SPACE: A large, brightly lit indoor border/customs waiting hall. Concrete ceiling with exposed red fire sprinkler pipes, grey ventilation ducts, cable trays, and rectangular suspended fluorescent fixtures. White painted walls and support pillars. Light-colored glossy tiled floor reflecting overhead lights. Upper clerestory windows along the right wall. Multiple travelers are seated or standing throughout the hall: a passenger in a white t-shirt sits looking at a phone in the center row; another passenger in a pink collared shirt and dark trousers sits cross-legged to the right; passengers with bags and wheeled luggage nearby. OBJECTS: In my possession is a light blue/grey hard-shell rolling suitcase with an extendable handle. Across the hall are multiple rows of 3-to-4-seat silver perforated metal waiting chairs with curved armrests. On the floor nearby are travel bags, backpacks, a white wheeled suitcase, and a yellow folding '小心地滑' (Caution Wet Floor) sign. A red wall-mounted fire hose cabinet labeled '消火栓' and a green illuminated emergency exit sign are mounted on the wall. SCREEN CONTENT: No active computer or phone screens facing me in foreground; distant travelers hold mobile phones. TEXT IN THE WORLD: Large rear wall scenic mural showing the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge with slogan '合作共赢 圆梦来珠海'; adjacent sign 'I ❤️ ZH 来了就是珠海人'; roll-up banner '『走水』违法 依法严惩'; health advisory posters on the right pillar including '疟疾'. MEDIA BEING PLAYED: None. AMBIENT AUDIO: Indoor room acoustics, faint footsteps, rolling luggage wheel rumble, and murmurs of waiting passengers.

screen_text.label: Xiaohongshu AI summary - Live photo shooting guide
text: 想在微信里分享生动有趣的实况照片或视频，其实很简单！无论是记录生活中的小惊喜，还是分享旅行的精彩瞬间，掌握下面几个步骤就能轻松搞定。
• 苹果手机：打开相机，你会在取景框顶部看到一个黄色的“实况”图标，点一下让它变成黄色就代表开启了。拍照时，相机会自动捕捉按下快门前后的动态画面。
• 安卓手机：不同品牌叫法不同，但通常在相机的拍照模式里能找到“动态照片”或“实况”选项，点亮即可开启。特别提醒：很多安卓手机（如华为）退出相机后，这个开关会自动关闭，下次拍照前一定要重新打开！
• 按下快门后别急着放手：多等1-2秒，这样相机会记录下更完整的动态瞬间，画面也更清晰。
• 保持手机稳定：尽量别抖动或快速移动镜头，可以借助支架或把手机放在平面上来固定，避免动态画面模糊。

segments.environment: Physical Space: Inside a passenger cabin on the '新海驰' (Xin Hai Chi) XXX-speed ferry. Cabin is bright with overhead lights and a ceiling curve. text_visible: 按下快门后别急着放手：多等1-2秒，这样相机会记录下更完整的动态瞬间，画面也更清晰。
保持手机稳定：尽量别抖动或快速移动镜头，可以借助支架或把手机放在平面上来固定，避免动态画面模糊。

segments.environment: Interior passenger cabin of the passenger ferry '新海驰' (BlueSeajet-95). White paneled ceiling with flush rectangular light panels, air conditioning vents, overhead safety handrails, and large passenger windows on the left letting in daytime sunlight. Forward seats are upholstered in blue fabric with white headrest slipcovers printed with '珠海海岛随心达 九洲港/香洲港出发' timetables. Seat 29 in front features a folded gray plastic tray table with a cup recess and a blue-and-white sticker labeled '29' and '扫码使用卫星WiFi', and an elastic pocket below containing a safety brochure marked '新海驰 XIN HAI CHI'. To the right is seat 28 in purple fabric with a '救生衣穿着法 How to use the lifejacket' card in its pocket. To the left is seat 30, where another passenger sits looking towards the window. In the right foreground, a companion sits wearing light mint/white trousers with their hands resting together.

segments.environment: Physical space: Enclosed passenger cabin of the '新海驰' (Xin Hai Chi) XXX-speed ferry boat. Rows of passenger seats feature blue-grey fabric with white headrest covers. Large rectangular glass windows along the left side offer a clear view of open deep-blue ocean water with rolling whitecap waves under a bright, overcast sky. Overhead white ceiling panels feature recessed rectangular lighting fixtures and ceiling-mounted CCTV cameras. Other passengers are seated in front rows; a male passenger sits directly ahead in seat 30, and another passenger sits across the aisle in seat 29. Objects: A folded blue-and-white plaid flannel jacket rests on the seat cushion beside me next to black shoes and a cream-colored handbag strap. The back of seat 30 directly ahead has a fold-down tray table, a seat number label '30', a satellite WiFi sticker, and an advertisement card tucked into the fabric cover. Text in world: '九洲港/香洲港出发 珠海海岛随心达', '扫码使用卫星WiFi', '30', '29', '新海驰 XIN HAI CHI', '九洲港/香洲港往返各海岛航班信息'. Media/Displays: Overhead television monitors down the cabin aisle display travel and scenic promotional videos. Ambient audio: Continuous low hum and vibration of the marine diesel engine combined with the whoosh of ocean water rushing against the ferry hull.

segments.environment: Physical space: Passenger cabin interior of the XXX-speed ferry '新海驰' (Zhuhai XXX Speed Passenger Ferry / 珠海高速客轮有限公司). Curved white ceiling with recessed LED lighting panels and overhead air conditioning vents, carpeted cabin deck, white wall pillars framing large rectangular picture windows. Several rows of blue fabric-cushioned passenger seats with white linen headrest covers and folding grey tray tables. Outside the window: terminal pier concrete bulkhead, calm seawater below, and a large yellow steel passenger boarding bridge/gantry structure. People: A female companion sits immediately to my left wearing a black short-sleeved top, dark sunglasses rested on her head, and a blue/red/white checkered blanket over her lap. In front of her sits another passenger in seat 30, and other seated passengers are XXX further forward in the cabin. Objects: Seat 30 in front has a headrest slipcover printed with '九洲港/香洲港出发 珠海海岛随心达', a folded plastic tray table with a blue sticker '扫码使用卫星WiFi 30', and a seat pocket holding a safety card labeled 'XIN HAI CHI'. A clear plastic water bottle rests on my companion's lap. Screen content: An overhead display monitor is XXX further down the cabin aisle showing arrival and flight connection notices. Ambient audio: Ferry cabin PA broadcast announcement plays over speakers: '请前往港澳码头的旅客，带好全部行李物品，准备离船。感谢你选择珠海高速客轮有限公司的航班，下次旅途再会，谢谢。继续前往中港城码头的旅客，请留在座位上休息等候，稍后我们将继续航行。感谢您的支持与配合。' accompanied by continuous engine vibration and air conditioning hum.

segments.environment: I am riding a downward escalator inside the spacious multi-story atrium of Shun Tak Centre in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong. The ceiling above consists of parallel curved acoustic metal slats fitted with grid-aligned circular LED downlights. Along the left wall is a multi-story vertical green living plant wall framed by polished grey granite panels. The escalator has grooved metallic steps with yellow perimeter safety lines, transparent glass balustrades, and black rubber handrails. In my right hand in the XXX foreground, I hold a compact white hardshell suitcase. Immediately ahead of me stands my female companion wearing a black off-shoulder top and checkered trousers. Below, the ground floor lobby concourse (marked 'G' on a prominent cylindrical structural pillar) features light grey polished floor tiles, an elevator bank on the far left surrounded by stanchion rope barriers, and another set of escalators on the right. In the far background, large glass exit doors open to the bright outdoor street where vehicles and pedestrians are XXX. Ambient sounds include the mechanical hum of moving escalators, background chatter of pedestrians echoing across the atrium, and distant traffic noise.

text: 图灵奖得主 Sutton 新作：用一个 1967 年的公式，解决流式强化学习 一大缺陷
2024年末，一篇名为《流式强化学习处于停滞状态》的论文...
论文中，作者来自阿尔伯塔大学的 Mahmood 团队。他们花了大篇幅描述了一个令人尴尬的现实：强化学习作为一种天生应该「边走边学」的方法，在深度神经网络时代却几乎无法做到这一点。只要去掉回放缓冲区，只要把批量大小设为 1，训练就会崩溃。他们称之为「流式壁垒」(stream barrier)。
